title: AI and automation
learning_outcomes: Explain automation versus AI in the context of ai and automation.
Compare and distinguish data boundaries in the context of ai and automation.
Apply human review and evals in the context of ai and automation.
Evaluate and justify decisions about build buy fallback in the context of ai and automation.

lessons.title: Automation versus AI
lessons.outcome: Explain automation versus AI in the context of ai and automation.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving automation versus ai; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to ai workflow specification.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain automation versus ai from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of automation versus ai; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.
assessment.reviewer: Practitioner with relevant business, technology or privacy expertise.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
